summary: Added mesh-anchor grass mode: CPU samples deterministic area-weighted anchors from the map collider's upward-facing triangles (chunk-clipped via Sutherland-Hodgman) and streams them into GPU chunk slots that a new anchorCull kernel culls instead of procedural placement - grass now sits on cave floors/overhangs/floating islands instead of the top-down heightfield envelope.

Added a map picker dropdown to section 4 of biome-explainer.html so the real-map minimap can load any *-data.json in maps/workshop/ (not just test_export), resetting canvas listeners on switch to avoid stacking.

Export family JSON now POSTs to a new serve.py /api/save-family endpoint that writes families/<slug>.json and appends it to families/manifest.json (falls back to manual download if the server lacks the endpoint), removing the manual drop-file/edit-manifest steps; also backfilled vegetation.md's Game integration section, which had been lost when a later unrelated edit overwrote the file.
